facts: The member has an overdue loan balance.
masked_input.policy_clause: A member is in good standing when there is no unpaid balance on any account. The Account Standing policy explains what counts as unpaid.

response.reply: Hi {{first_name}}, thank you for reaching out. We reviewed the $35 Courtesy Pay fee charged to Everyday Checking on Sep 14. We can't refund this fee because there is an unpaid amount on your overdue loan, and our policy requires no unpaid amounts on any account for a member to be in good standing. If you need anything else, please reply to this message.
